description: This file contains unit tests for the PIMLeftMenuService class within the OrangeHRM project. The tests verify menu item accessibility, cache management, and permission checks related to the Personnel Information Management (PIM) feature.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the PIMLeftMenuService, including menu retrieval, cache management, and permission checks.

methods.name: getAllMenuItems
methods.description: Mocks the getAvailableActions method of PIMLeftMenuService to simulate enabling or disabling the tax menu, returning available menu actions.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsAllMenusAccessible
methods.description: Tests scenario where all menu items are accessible to the user and verifies correct menu retrieval.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsOnlyDependentsAccessible
methods.description: Tests scenario where only the 'viewDependents' menu is accessible based on user permissions.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployee
methods.description: Verifies cache clearing for a specific employee's menu items.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuOneEmployeeNotCached
methods.description: Ensures cache behaves correctly when the employee's menu items are not cached.

methods.name: testClearCachedMenuAll
methods.description: Tests clearing the entire menu cache.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleTrue
methods.description: Verifies that PIM features are accessible when permissions are granted.

methods.name: testIsPimAccessibleFalse
methods.description: Verifies that PIM features are not accessible when permissions are denied.
